title: 2026년 10월 16일, 인공지능 분야에서 무슨 일이 일어났을까요?
intro: Agent builders got concrete controls today: Grafana applied SLOs and error budgets to agent behaviour, and Cloudflare began continuously auditing Verified bots.
On the model side, Reflection's open-weight Beam launched with day-0 vLLM and AWS support, while DeepSeek's near 5-hour outage underlined how tight inference capacity is.
highlights: Grafana proposes SLOs and error budgets to measure AI agent behaviour.
Cloudflare adds continuous accountability checks for Verified bots.
Reflection Beam-1.0 (501B total, 23B active) lands with day-0 vLLM and AWS SageMaker support.
vLLM reports Kimi K3 on AMD MI355X matching NVIDIA HGX B300 per-GPU throughput.
DeepSeek suffers a nearly 5-hour outage amid chip shortage.
AWS open-sources Strands Decider 2B and Strands Box.
